scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - ICU ROOM - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - ICU ROOM - NIGHT
Emergency alarms blare as twenty-four-year-old nurse Harper rushes to perform chest compressions on eighty-one-year-old Evelyn Whitmore.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Clear the line, her heart rate is crashing!

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Save her, Harper, she is the only real family I have left.
Harper stabilizes the cardiac monitor just as stepmother Diane glares through the glass window.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - NIGHT
Seventeen-year-old Mia adjusts the black sling on her injured left arm as she hands Harper a bottle of water.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: You saved the matriarch, but Cole's half-brother will not stop watching you.
Twenty-nine-year-old sales head Jake Whitmore steps close to Harper and gently grabs her arm.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Cole is just a broke mechanic, Harper, while I can give you everything.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Cole paid one hundred thousand dollars for Mia's heart surgery, so back off, Jake.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Ask your mechanic husband why he carries an encrypted executive smartphone.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - NURSES' STATION - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - NURSES' STATION - NIGHT
Fifty-eight-year-old Diane Whitmore secretly opens the automated medicine dispenser with a stolen badge.
Diane swaps Evelyn's IV bag for a lethal potassium dose logged under Harper's credentials.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: When Evelyn dies, Cole loses his inheritance and his little nurse wife takes the murder charge.
Harper picks up the digital chart at the counter and gasps at the unauthorized lethal order.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Someone used my nurse ID to order a fatal drug dose for Evelyn!
